en: The postcard features an old black-and-white photograph of a tree-lined avenue leading up to a large building, with an ornate gate and steps visible in the foreground. The text 'Sundsvalls Tivoli.' is printed at the bottom of the image. The reverse side contains handwritten Swedish text, a 5 öre green Swedish postage stamp, and is addressed to a recipient in Stockholm.
